content: NestJS CORS for cookie-based cross-origin auth: app.enableCors({ origin: [allowlist], credentials: true }) - origin must be an explicit array, never '*', when credentials:true is set. Refresh cookie: res.cookie(name, token, { httpOnly:true, secure: true in prod, sameSite:'lax'|'strict', domain: env-configurable, path:'/auth/refresh', maxAge }). cookie-parser middleware required to read cookies server-side.
